ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the rhombus $ABCD$, the diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ intersect at point $O$, and $H$ is the midpoint of side $AD$. If the perimeter of the rhombus $ABCD$ is $24$, what is the length of $OH$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since in the rhombus $ABCD$, the perimeter is 24, \\
it follows that $OA=OC$, $CD=24\div 4=6$, \\
since $H$ is the midpoint of side $AD$, \\
it follows that $OH=\frac{1}{2}CD=\boxed{3}$.
